rows.label: Negate
rows.note: Wyrm-exclusive precept: blocks one status effect, then a cooldown
rows.alt: tradeable - a friend can hand it to you instead

conditions: Negate does not replace Primed Sure Footed: it blocks one instance, then goes on cooldown, and a resistance blocking a status effect still consumes the charge.
Doesn't work while Wyrm is inactive, such as during Titania's Razorwing.
bonuses: Pair with Manifold Bond (Ostron Rank 3 Trusted, 20,000 standing) - its cooldown reduction also applies to Negate since Update 37.0.
Put Negate in the bottom-right precept slot; the wiki notes it can block precepts later in priority from firing.

disclosures.title: not required, but why anyone builds this today
disclosures.body: Nobody farms Wyrm for its base kit anymore. Negate is the entire reason, and it works identically on base Wyrm and Wyrm Prime.
